description: Election Commission - Declare that Mr. H. M. D. B. Herath as a member of the 8th Parliament (Vacated being death of Hon. Salinda Dissanayaka)
reasoning: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a parliamentary vacancy due to the death of a member and the subsequent declaration of a new elected member. This is a direct matter concerning electoral processes and the composition of parliament, falling under the category of Elections Gazettes (Type 7).
